cards.text: Brand new book, baker! These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth, in the territory of Benjamin. Grab an apron, because I bet this man did NOT see his new job coming.
The word of the LORD first comes to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.

It keeps coming through the days of King Jehoiakim, Josiah's son, all the way to the fifth month of the eleventh year of King Zedekiah, another son of Josiah. That's not a job, friend, that's a CAREER!

cards.question: Jeremiah's messages from the LORD run until Zedekiah's eleventh year. What happens to the people of Jerusalem then?

cards.text: Now Jeremiah tells it himself: "The word of the LORD came to me, saying:" And what the LORD tells him goes WAY back, friend, further back than Jeremiah can remember.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah He knew him before He formed him in the ___.
The LORD says that before Jeremiah was born, He set him apart and appointed him as a ___.

cards.text: A prophet to the nations! Then Jeremiah answers, and it starts with "Ah, Lord GOD," which is never how a yes starts. I'm not judging, friend, because when an angel showed up at my junk drawer, I asked him if he had the right drawer.

cards.question: Jeremiah tells the LORD he surely doesn't know how to do something, because he's only a child. What is it?

cards.text: The LORD tells him, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.'" That excuse lasted about as long as a warm cookie on the cooling rack.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah he can pick which of the LORD's commands he wants to speak.
The LORD tells Jeremiah not to be afraid of the people, because He is with him to ___ him.

cards.text: Then the LORD reaches out His hand and touches Jeremiah's mouth. Yes, friend, THAT mouth, the one that just said it doesn't know how to speak!

cards.question: When the LORD touches Jeremiah's mouth, what does He say He has put there?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He has appointed Jeremiah today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow. Day one, friend, no training video, no orientation, just GO!

cards.question: After uprooting and tearing down, the LORD's list for Jeremiah's job also includes building and planting.

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes again with a question: "Jeremiah, what do you see?" Jeremiah says he sees a branch of an almond tree, and if that were me, I'd be sweating like the boss just called on me in a meeting.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah he has seen the almond branch correctly.
The LORD says Jeremiah saw the almond branch right. What does the LORD say He is watching over?

answers.text: His word to make it happen

cards.text: Again the word of the LORD comes: "What do you see?" This time Jeremiah sees a boiling pot, and it's TILTING toward them from the north.

cards.question: The LORD explains the tilting pot: ___ from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land.

cards.text: The LORD declares He is about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north. Their kings will come, and friend, they will NOT be coming for cookies.

cards.question: The kings from the north will set up their ___ at the entrance of Jerusalem's gates.

cards.text: They will attack Jerusalem's walls and all the other cities of Judah. Then the LORD says He will pronounce His judgments against the people of the land for all their wickedness.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say He will pronounce His judgments against the people of the land?

answers.text: They left Him for other gods
They made a treaty with Egypt
They let the temple fall into ruins

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Jeremiah, "Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you." No snooze button on this alarm, friend.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah not to be ___ by the people, or He will terrify him before them.

cards.text: Then the LORD says that this day He has made Jeremiah "like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls…" From only a child to LIKE an iron pillar, friend, that is a GLOW-UP!

cards.question: The LORD makes Jeremiah like a fortified city with bronze walls. Against whom?

answers.text: The whole land and its leaders

cards.question: The LORD ends by promising Jeremiah that no one will ever fight against him.

cards.text: The LORD closes with this: "They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you," declares the LORD.
